messages:
Mira (Product): Dropped a compact flow for the Audit > Export modal. Need quick UX + security + a11y sweep before we lock copy.
Sam (Design): scanning now. First pass: rename 'Presets' -> 'Saved views' for clarity. Also the retention control is noisy 1: group common buckets (30/90/365) and put 'Custom' last.
Matt (Eng): FYI CSV header order today is `timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days`. Changing visible labels will break customer parsers. We should emit a companion manifest with header aliases.
Elaine (Security): If export contains any KMS identifiers/aliases we must show a clear caution: "Export contains key metadata. Verify destination and retention policies before downloading." Also log an audit event on opt-in.
Aria (A11y): a11y checklist: 1) saved-views menu needs arrow-key nav & focus visible; 2) filter chips should be `role=button` with `aria-pressed`; 3) when user starts export announce "Export started" and progress updates via `aria-live=polite`.
Sam (Design): visual nit: the KMS lock badge (12px purple) has low-contrast tooltip text. Options: add inline label 'KMS', increase badge size to 16px, or use a high-contrast tooltip background. Prefer adding a label for clarity.
Mira (Product): agree on label + manifest. Also retitle retention label to 'Retention period' in UI; backend will map to `retention_days`.
Matt (Eng): implementation plan: emit `export_manifest.json` next to CSV with `export_version`, `headers`, `header_aliases`. Add an opt-in checkbox "Include key metadata" default OFF. For enterprise orgs require typed confirmation: `I understand this export contains key metadata`.
Elaine (Security): +1. Typed confirmation required for enterprise. Add a short link to the export guidance doc and include the audit log when users opt in.
Aria (A11y): modal needs a focus trap, initial focus on the typed input, and `aria-describedby` pointing to the security blurb. Validation errors must be announced.
Sam (Design): microcopy proposals: button states: `Download CSV` and `Download CSV (includes key metadata)` when checked. Tooltip: `Includes audit fields. Only include key metadata if necessary.` KMS badge alt: `KMS-protected field`.
Matt (Eng): dev impact small. I'll add the manifest + header_aliasing and the checkbox. Feature-flag the typed-confirm for enterprise. ETA: end of week for review.
opsbot: deploy-preview created for branch `feature/audit-export-clarity`  http://preview/redwood/exp-224 (auto)
Mira (Product): owners: Matt (backend), Sam (copy/visuals), Aria (a11y sign-off), Elaine (security copy). I'll assemble the PR checklist and land copy tomorrow if no objections. :thumbsup:
